title: HtmlTbody
responsibility: Renders the native tbody element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlTbody.attributes
inputs.description: Native tbody attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlTbody.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native tbody element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlTbody
outputs.description: The actual native tbody element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
